The proposal does not cite or learn from this result, and it was not shipped.","evidence_quote":"Give customers a more generous arrival range by adding 10 extra minutes of cushion in the three worst zones, to lift on-time rate.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-014, explain how this test differs (zone targeting, switchback design), and state how it will avoid the same on-time gain that comes only from looser promises."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"No conversion guardrail for a promise-window change","detail":"EXP-014's learning says promise changes must be judged on Promise Accuracy and conversion, not on on-time rate alone.
